monitor_at_home.title: Monitor at Home
monitor_at_home.description: This option may be suitable for mild symptoms when there are no warning signs and the person is otherwise well.
actions: Rest and allow your body time to recover.
Monitor whether symptoms are improving, staying the same, or getting worse.
Keep track of any new symptoms.
Seek medical advice if symptoms persist, recur, or become more severe.
when_to_change_plan: Daily activities become difficult because of the symptoms.

routine_medical_consultation.title: Routine Medical Consultation
routine_medical_consultation.description: Consider speaking with a doctor or qualified healthcare professional when symptoms persist, recur, or interfere with normal daily activities.
reasons: Symptoms interfere with school, work, sleep, or daily activities.
A medical examination or testing may be needed.
You have an existing medical condition that may affect the symptoms.
routine_medical_consultation.recommended_action: Arrange an appointment with a qualified healthcare professional.

prompt_medical_consultation.title: Prompt Medical Consultation
prompt_medical_consultation.description: Contact a healthcare professional soon when symptoms are concerning but there is no clear sign of an immediate emergency.
examples: Repeated vomiting or difficulty maintaining hydration.
New symptoms that are concerning or unusual.
Symptoms occurring in someone who may be medically vulnerable.
prompt_medical_consultation.recommended_action: Contact a doctor or qualified healthcare professional as soon as reasonably possible.

emergency_care.title: Emergency Care
emergency_care.description: Immediate emergency medical attention is appropriate when severe or potentially life-threatening warning signs are present.
warning_signs: Sudden weakness or numbness on one side.
Severe allergic reaction with breathing difficulty or swelling.
Sudden severe headache with neurological symptoms.
Severe dehydration or inability to keep fluids down.
Any rapidly worsening condition that feels life-threatening.
emergency_care.recommended_action: Seek immediate local emergency medical assistance or go to the nearest emergency department.
